faqs.question: What is an HS code and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: The Harmonized System (HS) code is a standardised number used worldwide to classify traded goods. It decides the duty you pay, which regulations apply and whether your shipment clears customs smoothly. A wrong code can mean overpaid duty, delays or penalties.

faqs.question: How accurate is HSCodeMatch?
faqs.answer: Our engine reaches around 98% accuracy at the 6-digit level on benchmark data. Every suggestion includes a confidence score and the reasoning behind it, so your team can review edge cases quickly.

faqs.question: Can I classify products in bulk?
faqs.answer: Yes. On the Premium and Business plans you can upload a CSV or connect via API to classify thousands of SKUs at once.

faqs.question: Which countries' tariff schedules are supported?
faqs.answer: We support national tariff schedules for 150+ countries, including the US HTS, EU TARIC, UK Global Tariff, China, Japan and India.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Every account starts with a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required and you can cancel anytime.

faqs.question: What kind of support is included?
faqs.answer:
We offer tier-based support depending on your plan:

- Free plan users get access to community forums and our self-serve Help Center.
- Pro & Business users enjoy priority email support and live chat during business hours.
- Enterprise plans come with a dedicated success manager and 24/7 assistance.

📌 Need more details? [View our full support options in the Help Center →](/support)

faqs.question: Can I switch plans mid-billing cycle?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades apply from your next billing date, so you keep everything you've paid for.

faqs.question: How do API lookups count against my limit?
faqs.answer: Each successful classification request counts as one lookup. Batch requests count one lookup per product in the batch. Failed or invalid requests are never charged.

faqs.question: Does the software provide binding legal advice?
faqs.answer: No. HSCodeMatch gives AI-assisted recommendations with supporting rationale. For legally binding decisions, request a Binding Tariff Information ruling from the relevant customs authority.

faqs.question: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faqs.answer: Yes — yearly billing saves 20% compared with paying month to month.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: All major credit cards, plus bank transfer and invoicing for Business and Enterprise plans.

pages.title: About HSCodeMatch
pages.summary: We help importers, exporters and customs brokers classify products accurately and quickly.
pages.body:
HSCodeMatch combines the Harmonized System nomenclature, national tariff schedules and customs rulings with AI to suggest the right HS code for any product description — with the reasoning behind every match.

## Our mission

Customs classification decides the duty you pay, the paperwork you need and the risk you carry. We want every trade team, from a one-person exporter to a global broker, to classify with the confidence of a specialist.

## What we offer

- **AI classification** with confidence scores and alternative headings
- **Tariff and duty lookups** for 180+ countries
- **A developer API** to classify products inside your own systems
- **Expert support** from licensed customs professionals

## Company

HSCodeMatch is built by Jureem Pte. Ltd., headquartered in Singapore. [Contact us](/contact/) to talk to our team.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.summary: How HSCodeMatch collects, uses and protects your personal data.
pages.body:
This policy explains what personal data Jureem Pte. Ltd. (“HSCodeMatch”, “we”) collects through our website and services and how we use it.

## Data we collect

- **Account details:** name, email address, company and an encrypted password
- **Messages:** what you send through our contact and expert inquiry forms
- **Newsletter:** your email address if you subscribe
- **Usage data:** basic technical logs needed to run and secure the service

## How we use it

We use your data to provide the service, answer your requests, send the newsletter you asked for and keep our systems secure. We do not sell personal data.

## Storage and security

Data is stored with reputable cloud providers. Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text. Access is limited to staff who need it.

## Your rights

You can update your profile from your account page, unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time, and ask us to access or delete your data by emailing [contact@hscodematch.com](mailto:contact@hscodematch.com).

## Changes

We will post any changes to this policy on this page.
